description.value: Jack's Place, co-located with Kuma Sushi, is a casual lunch and dinner patio hangout at Bear Mountain in Langford, BC, offering a wide-ranging menu of comfort food, wood-fired pizza, sushi rolls, and handcrafted cocktails. The eclectic menu — spanning halibut tacos, poke bowls, dragon rolls, and meatball sliders — makes it a satisfying mid-ride or post-ride meal stop for cyclists exploring the Bear Mountain and Langford area west of Victoria. Online ordering and gift cards are available.
